BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: Bitewings (one, two, three, four images), intraoral tomosynthesis (bitewing radiographic image): 1 per calendar year. Intraoral tomosynthesis (periapical radiographic image): 8 per calendar year.
Inlays, Onlays, Crowns including core buildup, pins, post and core-1 per tooth per 60 months
Root canal therapy, anterior, premolar, molar: 1 per tooth per lifetime.

Periodontal maintenance-2 per 12 months following periodontal therapy
Periodontal scaling and root planing-1 per quadrant per 24 months
Gingevectomy/gingivoplasty once per quadrant per 36 months.

Removable dentures (complete, partial, immediate): 1 per 60 months. Adjustments: 1 per 6 months. Repair, replace teeth: 3 per 60 months. Replace all teeth, rebase, reline, soft liner, metal substructure: 1 per 12 months.
Dental implants covered 1 every sixty months, per tooth per member. Limit of two implants per calendar year per member.

Fixed partial dentures:  Pontics (resin, base metal, noble metal, porcelain or titanium), inlays, onlays, crowns and retainers: 1 per tooth per 60 months.  Recement or re-bond fixed partial denture: once per 60 months.
